description: Whether a legacy (non-dynamic, no cm) formula intersects a comparison over a range inside AND, OR and XOR, as it does inside SUM (legacy-value-argument-intersection), or evaluates it as an array: the corpus's legacy IF(OR(AND(Department="GERON",Course_Number=255)),..) over whole-column names. L1:L5 = 10..50, A1:A5 = 50..10; row 2 is on the ranges' rows (L2 = 20, A2 = 40), row 12 off them. C: intersected FALSE, as an array TRUE; E and F: intersected TRUE, as an array FALSE; G: XOR; H: a bare range (read whole, TRUE on both rows); I: the name lvals = $L$1:$L$5; J: under IF. Row 20 shows the formulas' text. Taskei: the corpus-fix lane's recalc.budget item.
